name: FrenchModelVariant177_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant177_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-160/290 and Japanese images build the same source through model_variant/variant177_entry_usa.c (VARIANT177_PRINT_WORK_SIZE adds the work-size printf; GRAPHICS_DEFAULT_HEIGHT 240), with the US images binding gFrenchModelVariant177_D119C 0x14 higher; gFrenchModelVariant177_D11AC, gFrenchModelVariant177_D1200 0x24 higher than the French images (notes/overlays/usa-model-french-entries.md). Not the US header-177 source model_variant/variant177_entry.c. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
